findings.rationale: grep_repo and read_file show create_code_interpreter builds request_params with networkConfiguration=network_configuration or {"networkMode": "PUBLIC"} (line 173). The flagged test test_create_code_interpreter_minimal asserts exactly this PUBLIC default (test file line 120), so the tests corroborate that omitting network_configuration silently provisions a publicly networked interpreter rather than failing closed. This is the production behavior the hotspot tests exercise.
findings.title: create_code_interpreter defaults networkConfiguration to PUBLIC

findings.rationale: read_file shows delete_code_interpreter(interpreter_id, client_token) forwards client_token verbatim into request_params["clientToken"] (line 208) with no format/length validation, and the flagged test test_delete_code_interpreter_with_client_token passes "test-token" through. The same pattern exists in browser_client.py lines 186-206. This is an idempotency-token passthrough, not a credential, so impact is limited, but it is the production path the flagged tests cover.
findings.title: delete_code_interpreter accepts caller-supplied client_token without validation

findings.rationale: grep_repo locates download_file at line 583 and download_files at line 621 in src/bedrock_agentcore/tools/code_interpreter_client.py, matching the flagged tests test_download_file_text (test line 988), test_download_file_binary (1025), test_download_file_not_found (1059) and test_download_files_empty_result (1116). The tests mock the data plane client, so the filesystem_entry tag on the hotspots refers to sandbox-side file paths passed as strings; no local filesystem write was observed in the inspected source.
findings.title: download_file/download_files are the production targets of the flagged download tests

findings.rationale: All eight flagged functions (test_create_code_interpreter_minimal, test_create_code_interpreter_with_all_options, test_delete_code_interpreter, test_delete_code_interpreter_with_client_token, test_download_file_binary, test_download_file_not_found, test_download_file_text, test_download_files_empty_result) live in tests/bedrock_agentcore/tools/test_code_interpreter_client.py. Reading the file confirms they are pytest test methods that mock boto3, get_control_plane_endpoint and get_data_plane_endpoint, so the auth_boundary/crypto/filesystem_entry/network_entry/parser tags reflect the mocked production surface, not reachable production code. The high score is driven by file-level loc=1139 and nesting=7 shared across all entries, not by per-function complexity.
findings.title: Complexity hotspots are all test functions in a single test file
